tasks.task_description: Check current project setup and dependencies
Verify Node.js and Yarn versions meet requirements
Check Android Studio and SDK setup
Verify Android TV emulator is available
Test running the Android TV app

description: Troubleshoot React Native Multi-TV Android app loading issues by following README and setting up proper Android TV emulator
context: ✅ Project setup verified - correct directory structure exists. ✅ Node.js v25.1.0 and Yarn v4.5.0 meet requirements (Node.js v18+ and Yarn v4.5.0 required).

✅ Dependencies installed with some warnings (normal for this project). ✅ Android SDK found at correct location. ✅ Android TV emulators available: Television_1080p, Trag_TV. Started Television_1080p emulator.

✅ Successfully built and installed Android TV app. ✅ Started correct TV emulator (Trag_TV with TV features). ✅ Installed app on TV emulator with package name com.anonymous.MultiTVSample. ✅ Launched app successfully on TV emulator.
